$comment: Rule catalog — engineering invariants. Standard 45. The meta-standard the rest of the framework rests on: every other check in this repository can be satisfied by deleting the check.

rules.title: Standards and tests are not weakened to permit an implementation
rules.description: No standard, test, applicability determination, evidence requirement, or verification mechanism is weakened, removed, bypassed, or reclassified solely to permit an implementation that would otherwise violate it.
rules.rationale: A framework whose rules yield to the code they judge is not judging anything. Revising a rule because it was wrong is ordinary work; revising it because the code under it fails is the failure this rule names, and the tell is that the change to the rule arrives after the implementation it unblocks.
rules.remediation: Restore the requirement and fix the implementation, or record the standard change on its own merits with the reasoning that would have applied had no implementation been pending.
rules.$assuranceNote: Not automatable: the violation is a claim about WHY a change was made, and intent is not in the diff. Attestation is the evidence mechanism.
